BattleSubject.bonusActionSpell.metamagic, BattleFill.kind, BattleHole.kind, BattleState.currentTurnResources, character spellcasting resources, character point-pool resources, and reducer route owner facts

notes: Task 31 introduced no new BattleState, BattleCreatureState, character spellcasting, or character point-pool durable field.
Action and Bonus Action availability remain BattleState.currentTurnResources.
The same-turn level-1-plus spell lock remains the existing turn resource fact; no duplicate Quickened lock was added.
Spell Slot spend remains character spellcasting resource state reached through the spell invocation.
Sorcery Point spend remains character point-pool resource state.
Selected Metamagic option identity remains a catalog, selection, admission, and SRD fixture boundary; runtime route evidence reads typed metamagic effectKind facts rather than option names.
Spell target selection, spell Attack roll, and rolled damage progress remain the existing public BattleHole frontier.
AvailableBattleAct.routeEvents and BattleResolutionResult.routeEvents are public reducer boundary projections, not a duplicated Quickened Spell ledger.
